bullets: It is a squashing function used to convert an unbounded values to a bounded probabilistic space (from 0 to 1)

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates via red color and top-left placement. Large white derivation boxes command central attention. Peach and blue accent boxes provide visual grouping. Body text is secondary black sans-serif.

visual_elements.description: Peach/light orange rectangular box containing the sigmoid definition formula f(x) = Sigmoid(x) = 1/(1+e^{-x})
Light blue rectangular box containing 'Remember:' and the derivative rule for 1/x
Large white rectangular box containing the first derivative derivation: f'(x) = e^{-x}/((1+e^{-x})(1+e^{-x})) = 1*(1+ e^{-x} - 1)/((1+e^{-x})(1+e^{-x}))
visual_elements.position: middle-left, spanning most of left column width

visual_elements.description: Peach/light orange rectangular box containing text: 'Sigmoid (aka Logistic function)' followed by description paragraph with italic and underlined words
White rectangular box containing two lines of f'(x) derivation with absolute value-style delimiters
Peach/light orange rectangular box with a red arrow pointing to the final simplified derivative formula f'(x) = f(x) [1 - f(x)]

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is red, larger and bold. Body text is dark gray/black. In the Sigmoid description box, 'squashing' is italicized, 'unbounded' and 'probabilistic' are underlined, and '(from 0 to 1)' is red and italicized.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#f0f0f0). 2. Add title 'For Sigmoid Function' at top-left in red (#c0392b), bold sans-serif. 3. Add yellow circle at top-right with black number '24'. 4. Create peach box (#fdf2e9) upper-left with formula: f(x) = Sigmoid(x) = \frac{1}{1+e^{-x}}. 5. Create light blue box (#e3f2fd) upper-right with text: Remember: \frac{\partial}{\partial x} (\frac{1}{x}) = - \frac{1}{x^2}. 6. Create large white box middle-left with first derivation: f'(x) = \frac{e^{-x}}{(1+e^{-x})(1+e^{-x})} = \frac{1*(1+ e^{-x} - 1)}{(1+e^{-x})(1+e^{-x})}. 7. Create peach box middle-right with header 'Sigmoid (aka Logistic function)' and body: 'It is a squashing function used to convert an unbounded values to a bounded probabilistic space (from 0 to 1)' — italicize 'squashing', underline 'unbounded' and 'probabilistic', make '(from 0 to 1)' red and italic. 8. Create white box lower-middle-left with two derivation lines using \left| ... \right| delimiters. 9. Create white box bottom-left with f'(x) = \frac{1}{(1+e^{-x})} \left| 1 - \frac{1}{(1+e^{-x})} \right|. 10. Create peach box bottom-right with red arrow ⇒ and formula f'(x) = f(x) [1 - f(x)].
